Hi Arianna — appreciate the clear asks. Quick read-through below and a proposed mutual action plan embedded here to hit your 9/10 procurement routing deadline. We attached a concise MAP summary (see referenced rows in the spreadsheet) and flagged owners.

High-level proposal (short):
- Canary window: we recommend Mid-October (10/11 — 10/25). Reason: allows two full weeks of integrated testing + one week burn-in before cohort training.
- Evaluation gates (UAT pass criteria):
  * Functional: 95% success on canonical prompts in the supplied testset (owner: Willowbrook QA).
  * Safety/regressions: no more than 2 safety escalations per 1k prompts (owner: Redwood Research Ops).
  * Latency & SLOs: P95 inference <= 450ms on dedicated pool for pilot traffic (owner: Redwood Platform).
- Migration approach: recommend 'staged cutover' (prefix routing + gradual traffic shift) — we will supply a rollback runbook if any gate trips.
- Training: two sessions — Admin (30–45 min) + Clinician workshop (90 min). We propose week of 10/25 for training to follow canary burn-in.

Mutual action timeline (key rows):
- 9/06: Redwood to provide finalized MAP rows + attachment (this email) — owner: Priyom
- 9/07: Willowbrook internal sign-off on canary window preference & procurement routing — owner: Arianna
- 9/30: Redwood delivery of canary runbook + test harness + monitoring dashboard links — owner: Karthik
- 10/11: Canary start (2 weeks) — owner: shared (Willowbrook ops + Redwood SRE)
- 10/25: Training cohort week (Admins + Clinicians) — owner: Monica + Willowbrook training lead
- 11/01: Phased migration to GA traffic (if gates green) — owner: shared

Attachments referenced:
- MAP summary rows (we called out specific milestone IDs in Willowbrook_MAP_DRAFT_vA.xlsx)
- Canary runbook (we will drop a separate link by 9/30)

Open questions for you:
1) Do you have preferred blackout dates in Oct/Nov for clinicians?
2) Who at Willowbrook will be the primary PM for acceptance gates (name + email)?
3) Any internal compliance questionnaire we need to complete before 9/10 procurement submission?

If you give us the go-ahead on the Mid-Oct window we will lock resource reservations and create a canary SLO dashboard.

Best,
Priyom Das
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Hi Arianna — looping in more detail on training and the evaluation plan. Quick bullets to make the MAP actionable: 

Canary & Migration (ops details)
- Canary cadence: 2-week canary with three validation checkpoints (Day 3, Day 7, Day 14). Each checkpoint has go/no-go criteria (passed/failed checklist attached in the runbook).
- Traffic phasing for cutover: 10% -> 35% -> 60% -> 100% over 48 hours if all checkpoints pass. Auto-roll back to previous model variant if safety gate trips.

Evaluation plan (succinct owner mappings)
- Redwood provides an automated harness to run the provided testset; results land in the shared dashboard (owner: Karthik).
- Willowbrook to run clinical acceptance (owner: Arianna + designated clinical lead).
- Regression alerts: Redwood will emit alerts to the shared Slack channel (we'll create a private Willowbrook channel).

Training (deliverables & schedule)
- Admin session: 30–45 min + admin quick-start packet (deliverable: Admin Quickstart PDF)
- Clinician workshop: 90-min hands-on, includes 2 simulated patient flows and 15-min Q&A (deliverable: Clinician workshop deck + recording)
- Proposed delivery: week of 10/25; Monica will host clinician rehearsal with Redwood clinical SMEs the week prior (10/18).

Reqs from Willowbrook for scheduling
- Confirm clinical blackout weeks (we can work around shift patterns).
- Provide a clinician roster (10–12 participants) and an acceptance PM name by 9/10.

I'll get the Admin Quickstart and the clinician slide deck stub to you by 9/15 so you can start internal distribution.

Thanks — happy to adjust timing if the procurement lifecycle demands an earlier kick.

— Monica Patel
Director, Customer Onboarding — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
